input.content:
Prepare the batch quality summary for Northstar.
Source documents: northstar-lab-batch-17.csv and northstar-calibration-17.csv.
Convert the raw measurements using the calibration table and calculate the number of records, mean hgb and mean glucose. Round final numeric results to two decimal places. Deliver JSON with records, mean_hgb and mean_glucose.
Provide a delivery summary when finished.

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"ls -la /workspace && cat /workspace/PLATFORM.md && printf '\\n--- sources ---\\n' && cat /workspace/northstar-lab-batch-17.csv && printf '\\n--- calibration ---\\n' && cat /workspace/northstar-calibration-17.csv"}

{"command":"python - <<'PY'
import csv, statistics
rows=list(csv.DictReader('''patient_id,hgb_raw,glucose_raw
NOR-001,15474,10152
NOR-002,15754,13977
NOR-003,11088,10122
NOR-004,14312,9573
NOR-005,16227,12268
NOR-006,12910,10947
NOR-007,14268,10323
NOR-008,11001,14441
NOR-009,12799,7148
NOR-010,11441,12581
NOR-011,16117,11805
NOR-012,16154,7507
'''.splitlines()))
for c in ['hgb_raw','glucose_raw']:
 vals=[int(r[c]) for r in rows]
 print(c,len(vals),sum(vals),statistics.mean(vals))
PY"}
